name: Chicago EYES on Cancer
org: University of Chicago Medicine Comprehensive Cancer Center
what_you_do: Students work full time in a University of Chicago cancer research lab for two summers. They also get monthly career workshops, talks and mentors. They present at a research event.
grades: High school sophomore, junior or senior (or college freshman or sophomore)
who_can_apply: High school sophomores, juniors or seniors who are at least 16 by June 14, 2027 and live in Cook, Lake, Will or DuPage counties in Illinois or Lake County, Indiana. College freshmen and sophomores can also apply. Must commit to both summers.
duration: Two summers of 8 weeks (2027: June 14 to Aug 6, 35 to 40 hours a week) plus monthly 2 to 4 hour online sessions from Feb 2027 to Dec 2028
deadline_text: Application and two recommendations due Nov 30, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. CT. In-person interviews Jan 4, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the common Pathway Programs online application (REDCap). Two people must send in recommendations. At least one must be a teacher or professor. Up to 12 applicants are accepted.
notes: You must find your own housing and ride to UChicago. The Illinois FAQ requires work permits only for workers under 16. It refers 16 and 17 year olds to federal rules. One application covers all the UChicago cancer pathway programs that fit you.
